rows.reviewer_context_quote: Each of two fresh helpers creates an owned 17x9 IOSurface and obtains a Mach-import CF alias and a numeric-global-lookup CF alias. All three CF wrapper pointers are distinct in both executions, while each lookup verifies the original surface ID. The helper deallocates its one resource Mach right and verifies its local name disappears before count measurements. With only CF wrappers retained, all three report local/global 0. Increment through the Mach-import alias makes all three local counts 1/global true. Increment through the global-lookup alias makes all three local counts 2/global true. Decrement through the original wrapper makes all three local counts 1/global true. Thus this balanced decrement crosses wrapper identity; the measured usage state belongs to shared per-process surface state, rather than an isolated counter on each wrapper.
